requirement: The system shall let an authorised user create a cohort definition with a unique name and store its expression.
The system shall let an authorised user change a cohort definition and keep the changed expression as the current one.
The system shall keep each saved change of a cohort definition as a version that can be listed and read back.
The system shall let a user copy a cohort definition (or one of its versions) to a new definition with a unique name.
The system shall let an authorised user delete a cohort definition together with its generation results.
The system shall let an authorised user generate a cohort definition on a named data source as a background job and return the job reference.
The system shall store, for each generation, every person and record that the cohort definition selects on the data source, so that the stored cohort equals the definition's result.
The system shall replace a cohort's earlier result when it is generated again, storing each record once and leaving other cohorts' results unchanged.
The system shall give the same generation result whether it reuses a cached result for an unchanged definition or computes it again, and shall recompute when the cached result is missing or invalid.
The system shall store the inclusion-rule, summary and censoring statistics of each generation and report them for the cohort and source.

The system shall show, per data source, the status of the latest generation and the number of people and records in its result, and shall only mark a generation valid when its stored result is complete.
The system shall record a failed or cancelled generation as not valid, clear its counts and keep a safe failure message.
The system shall let the user who can generate a cohort cancel a running generation on a source.
The system shall record who started each generation, when it started and how long it took.
The system shall only show generation results for data sources the user is permitted to access.
The system shall move a generation through PENDING, RUNNING and COMPLETE and show the current status to the user.
